payload.tension: The passage states mutual bodily authority, abstinence, and gift. Now about the things about which you wrote to me: it is good for a man not to touch a woman. Yet I wish that all men were like me. However, each man has his own gift from God, one of this kind, and another of that kind. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Paul's story.
